name: Spring Splasher, Yare — "target creature defending player controls" lists the attacked player's creatures
notes: Memory: project_audit_vocabulary_that_player_defending_player_2026-10-19. 'Defending player controls' was read as a required subtype ('Defending Player Control'), so Spring Splasher, Warkite Marauder, Armix, Fear of Falling, Orcish Squatters and Yare listed nothing. The defending player is the one your attackers attack (_defendingPlayerIds): Spring Splasher attacking lists the opponent's creatures; Yare, cast while the opponent's creature attacks you, lists yours.
